text: Toronto Centre is one of the busiest and most development-heavy wards in the city and province. The West Don Lands neighbourhood in particular is experiencing a surge in development applications. Many have been filed ahead of the Inclusionary Zoning by-law coming into effect. Along with community members, I am concerned that City Planning is not resourced properly and is already too back-logged with applications to handle the application surge. Some of the developments include the new hotel at Mill and Trinity, three large developments on the Triangle Lands, the Dream and Great Gulf developments to the South, the Transit-Oriented Community at First Parliament, and the three Ontario Line stations in Toronto Centre.
